decisions.reason: The portfolio-tile link is a separate request in the same message; the photo-selection change does not alter its Gallery destination.
Replacing indicated stock assets does not change the rule that each listed service must have a corresponding relevant image.
The specified replacement photos remain consistent with the existing sitewide image-focused design requirement and do not modify its visual-emphasis rule.
Selecting a house photograph changes the independently tracked homepage photo asset, not the existing design direction, image emphasis, or blue-overlay styling.
The photo replacements and homepage image subject do not change itemized pricing content, coverage, classification, or layout.
The source changes selected website image assets but does not alter the Gallery's scrolling behavior, tabs, or content organization.
The homepage photo changes do not alter the destinations of the existing Gallery, Pricing, and Services buttons.
The image-asset decision is unrelated to the deferred quote calculator's inputs, pricing logic, or output.
Changing homepage imagery and replacing stock photos does not modify the required animation level.
The source decision does not change the pricing-area navigation entry or its detailed-pricing destination.
The photo-selection changes do not affect package count, square-footage categories, or package prices.
Replacing image assets does not change whether Gallery hover animations are enabled on desktop or mobile.
